pulse.text: **Opus 5 has pulled clear of Fable 5** — Artificial Analysis now ranks Claude Opus 5 the outright #1 model on its Intelligence Index (**AA-Index 60**, v4.1) rather than tied, and at half the price ($5/$25) it's the cheapest model within 10% of the leader. That only tightens Anthropic's near-term grip: Polymarket's 'best model end of July' has compressed to **~99% Anthropic** (up from 95.5%), with Anthropic also holding second place at 95%. The loudest new thread is the buildout — **AMD will invest up to $5B in Anthropic** and deploy **2 GW of Instinct MI450 GPUs** in Helios racks (first gigawatt H1 2027), pulling Claude's compute partly off Nvidia. Watch the **Kimi K3 open-weights drop due Jul 27** (2.8T params, ~1.4TB even at 4-bit) and Google's next Gemini Pro, still stuck at **~73% to ship by Aug 7** after its Jul 17 target slipped. Otherwise a quiet evening — no new models since the 3PM Opus 5 launch.
